A '''palace''' was used by [[Szajin]] the Hutt, an [[Archon]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], on [[Makeb]].<ref name="Revenge of the Archon" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Archon Palace were added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' along with the rest of the planet Makeb in the [[2013]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref> The interior of the palace was designed by [[Christian Piccolo]], a concept artist who joined game developer Bioware in December 2011 and contributed to the SWTOR first expansions, including the "Rise of the Hutt Cartel".<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=cpiccolo|url=artwork/B9mWD|name=[[Christian Piccolo]]|text=Star Wars The Old Republic -The Planet Makeb}}</ref>

In the game there are two palaces on Makeb: Archon's Palace and [[Toborro's Palace]]. Because Toborro's Palace was built and designed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]<ref name="ToT">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Taking on Toborro|Makeb}}</ref>, Christian Piccolo's concept arts – the first one portraying a palace before and the second one after the takeover by [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] – have to depict Archon's Palace. It can be assumed that Archon Palace must have been built before the Conquest of Makeb and commandeered by Szajin, the Hutt Archon, after the planet's invasion by Hutt Cartel's forces. The characteristic white statues of animals seen in the artworks are also seen in Archon's Palace in the game. Although [[Toborro]] is seen on the second concept art, it is likely that he first took over the palace as his temporary headquarters and gave it to Szajin after Oggurobb built for him the new, bigger and more impressive, palace which became known as Toborro's Palace.
